_meta.title: Compatibility voiced descriptions (gift + book-grounded shadow)
_meta.note: Gift = natal_sign_story (Marie's reviewed voice). Shadow = grounded in As Above So Below's per-sign shadow lines ('an overly X sign energy can lead to...'); Virgo and Aquarius derived from the book's emphasis (perfection / rebellion). Tailored to each planet's domain.

sun.aries: Your identity comes through bold and direct: you'd rather start something than wait to be asked, though you can act before you think and charge in on impulse.
sun.taurus: You know who you are slowly and solidly, and you don't move until it feels worth it, though you can dig in and resist change until it costs you progress.
sun.gemini: Your sense of self runs on curiosity and talk; you try on ideas the way others try on clothes, though you can spread yourself thin and skim the surface.
sun.cancer: You're most yourself when you're caring for something, and you lead with feeling, though you can lose yourself in caretaking and forget your own needs.
sun.leo: You come alive when you're seen; your identity wants warmth, play, and something to create, though you can let pride tip into arrogance and need too much of the spotlight.
sun.virgo: You know yourself through what you refine and improve; being useful is how you shine, though you can chase perfection and be hard on yourself.
sun.libra: Your identity forms in relationship; you find yourself in the space between you and another, though you can lose yourself in others and struggle to decide.
sun.scorpio: You're most yourself in the deep end, where things are real, private, and intense, though you can get guarded, controlling, and slow to trust.
sun.sagittarius: Your sense of self needs room to roam: a bigger view, a truth to chase, a horizon, though you can get careless and dodge responsibility.
sun.capricorn: You know who you are by what you build and take responsibility for, though you can go rigid and tie your worth to what you achieve.
sun.aquarius: Your identity is a little outside the norm; you want to build things that shift the status quo, though you can detach, rebel for its own sake, and dig in on being right.
sun.pisces: You're most yourself at the edges, where feeling, imagination, and compassion blur the lines, though you can drift, avoid, and let your boundaries blur.

moon.aries: You feel things fast and hot, and you need to act on a mood before it cools, though you can flare up fast and act on a feeling before it cools.
moon.taurus: You settle when life is calm and physical; comfort, food, and steadiness soothe you, though you can get stuck in a mood and refuse to be moved.
moon.gemini: You process feelings by talking them out, and your mood shifts with the conversation, though you can talk around a feeling instead of actually feeling it.
moon.cancer: Your feelings run the show, and safety comes from home and the people who feel like yours, though you can over-give and neglect your own emotional needs.
moon.leo: You need warmth and a little spotlight to feel okay; affection lands loudest for you, though you can need too much reassurance and take a slight to heart.
moon.virgo: You feel safest when things are handled; a tidy detail can settle your whole mood, though you can pick your feelings apart and never feel done.
moon.libra: You feel steady when things are fair and harmonious, and conflict unsettles you fast, though you can keep the peace at the cost of your own needs.
moon.scorpio: Your feelings run deep and private, and you don't do shallow reassurance, though you can get jealous, guarded, and slow to let anyone in.
moon.sagittarius: You feel best with room to breathe and something to look forward to, though you can bolt from a heavy feeling and call it freedom.
moon.capricorn: You steady yourself with structure, and you'd rather handle a feeling than sit in it, though you can shut feelings down and call it fine before it is.
moon.aquarius: You need space to feel from a little distance; you process feelings by understanding them, though you can detach from your emotions and go cold.
moon.pisces: You soak up the emotional weather around you and feel everything at the edges, though you can soak up everyone else's feelings and lose your own.

mercury.aries: You think fast and say it faster; your mind moves in quick, direct bursts, though you can speak before you think and cut people off.
mercury.taurus: You think slowly and thoroughly, and once you've decided, you don't budge easily, though you can dig into an opinion and refuse to budge.
mercury.gemini: Your mind is quick, curious, and everywhere at once; you learn by talking and linking ideas, though you can scatter across topics and skim the surface.
mercury.cancer: You think with your feelings, and memory and mood color how you take things in, though you can let your mood color the facts.
mercury.leo: You think in big, confident strokes, and you speak to be heard and to inspire, though you can talk over others and need to be the smartest in the room.
mercury.virgo: Your mind is precise and analytical; you notice the error everyone else missed, though you can over-analyze and nitpick.
mercury.libra: You think in comparisons and both-sides, weighing every option before you commit, though you can see every side and never land on a decision.
mercury.scorpio: Your mind digs; you're not satisfied until you've found what's really going on, though you can get suspicious and read hidden motives everywhere.
mercury.sagittarius: You think in big pictures and possibilities, sometimes past the inconvenient details, though you can talk in broad strokes and skip the details.
mercury.capricorn: Your thinking is structured and practical; you want the plan, not the brainstorm, though you can go rigid and dismiss ideas that aren't practical.
mercury.aquarius: You think in systems and original angles, wired to question the obvious, though you can argue just to be contrary and detach from how people feel.
mercury.pisces: You think in images and intuition, following what feels true more than what's on paper, though you can drift, lose the thread, and mistake a hope for a fact.

venus.aries: You love fast and direct, and you'd rather chase than be kept guessing, though you can chase the spark and lose interest once you've won.
venus.taurus: You love steadily and sensually; loyalty, touch, and the good things say it best, though you can get possessive and cling to comfort over growth.
venus.gemini: You love through words and wit, and a good conversation is your love language, though you can get restless and need constant novelty.
venus.cancer: You love by caring and being cared for; closeness means feeling safe with someone, though you can smother, cling, and fear being left.
venus.leo: You love generously and out loud; you want romance with a little grandeur, though you can need to be adored and make it about you.
venus.virgo: You love through the practical: showing up, fixing, remembering the small things, though you can pick at your partner and withhold when it's imperfect.
venus.libra: You love beauty, balance, and partnership itself; harmony is the point, though you can lose yourself in the other and avoid conflict at any cost.
venus.scorpio: You love all the way in: intense, loyal, and allergic to anything halfway, though you can get jealous, possessive, and controlling in love.
venus.sagittarius: You love freedom and adventure in a partner; keep it honest and keep it moving, though you can dodge commitment and keep one foot out the door.
venus.capricorn: You love with commitment and staying power; you invest where it can last, though you can treat love like a duty and hold back your warmth.
venus.aquarius: You love as a friend first, and you need freedom inside the closeness, though you can keep love at arm's length and stay detached.
venus.pisces: You love romantically and boundlessly, seeing the best in whoever you fall for, though you can lose your boundaries and idealize whoever you fall for.

mars.aries: You go after what you want head-on, and sitting still is the hardest thing you do, though you can go off half-cocked and pick fights.
mars.taurus: You move slowly but you don't stop; your drive is stubborn and built to last, though you can dig in, stall, and refuse to move.
mars.gemini: Your energy goes into words and quick moves; you fight and flirt with your wit, though you can scatter your energy and argue instead of act.
mars.cancer: You act to protect what's yours, and your drive runs on feeling, not logic, though you can go passive-aggressive and act from hurt.
mars.leo: You act with flair and pride; you want your effort seen and your courage recognized, though you can make it about pride and sulk when unrecognized.
mars.virgo: Your energy goes into doing it right; you work hard and sweat the details, though you can nitpick and turn drive into anxious busywork.
mars.libra: You act through others and hate a fight, so you push by persuading, not shoving, though you can avoid conflict until it leaks out sideways.
mars.scorpio: Your drive is intense and strategic; you go quiet, then you go all the way, though you can get controlling and let anger go cold and vengeful.
mars.sagittarius: You chase the big goal with enthusiasm, sometimes overshooting the practical part, though you can act careless and burn out on impulse.
mars.capricorn: You work with discipline toward a real result; your ambition is patient and relentless, though you can grind past your limits and go cold.
mars.aquarius: You act on principle and your own timing, and you resist being told how to move, though you can rebel just to rebel and detach mid-fight.
mars.pisces: Your drive ebbs and flows with your mood; you move best toward something you believe in, though you can avoid confrontation and let your drive dissolve.

jupiter.aries: You grow by going first and betting on yourself; boldness tends to pay off for you, though you can leap without looking and burn out fast.
jupiter.taurus: You grow through patience and building; abundance comes to you slowly and stays, though you can grow so slowly you slide into complacency.
jupiter.gemini: You grow through learning and connecting; your luck runs through ideas and people, though you can chase every idea and go a mile wide, an inch deep.
jupiter.cancer: You grow through care and roots; your good fortune lives in home and belonging, though you can cling to the familiar and mistake comfort for growth.
jupiter.leo: You grow by expressing yourself fully; confidence and creativity open your doors, though you can let confidence tip into arrogance and excess.
jupiter.virgo: You grow through craft and usefulness; small, careful improvements compound for you, though you can shrink your vision with over-analysis and doubt.
jupiter.libra: You grow through relationship and fairness; partnership expands your world, though you can over-accommodate and lose your own direction.
jupiter.scorpio: You grow through depth and transformation; you gain by letting the shallow things go, though you can fixate and refuse to let the shallow things go.
jupiter.sagittarius: You grow by reaching for meaning and horizon; faith and adventure are your fuel, though you can over-promise, overreach, and dodge the follow-through.
jupiter.capricorn: You grow through discipline and structure; you earn your expansion the real way, though you can gatekeep growth behind rules and grind.
jupiter.aquarius: You grow through vision and community; your luck runs through the unconventional, though you can chase novelty and detach from what's practical.
jupiter.pisces: You grow through faith, art, and compassion; you gain by trusting the current, though you can drift on faith without grounding it in anything real.

saturn.aries: You build discipline around action: learning to start wisely, not just fast, though you can rush the work and resent the discipline.
saturn.taurus: Your structure is around worth and security; you learn what's truly enough, though you can harden into stubbornness and fear of change.
saturn.gemini: You build discipline around your mind and voice: say less, mean more, though you can scatter your focus and dodge the deep work.
saturn.cancer: Your work is around emotional security: building a foundation you didn't inherit, though you can wall off your feelings in the name of security.
saturn.leo: You learn to earn recognition rather than demand it; real confidence takes time, though you can let pride block the humility the lesson asks for.
saturn.virgo: Your discipline is around service and standards: useful, not perfect, though you can turn discipline into perfectionism and self-criticism.
saturn.libra: You build structure around commitment and fairness; you learn what you owe and are owed, though you can avoid the hard call and over-owe yourself to others.
saturn.scorpio: Your work is around trust and control: learning what's safe to depend on, though you can grip for control and struggle to trust the process.
saturn.sagittarius: You build discipline around belief: testing your faith instead of borrowing it, though you can dodge commitment and call it freedom.
saturn.capricorn: Your structure is around authority and time; you become your own hard-won authority, though you can overwork, go cold, and tie your worth to output.
saturn.aquarius: You build discipline around vision: turning ideals into things that actually hold, though you can rebel against structure and detach from the work.
saturn.pisces: Your work is around faith and boundaries: giving form to the formless, though you can avoid the boundary and let responsibility dissolve.
